extracted_decision.summary: Manager defined Task 278 scope: update repo docs and LLM.txt for new-user setup; update memory workflow for stdio-to-singleton migration; validate docs/skills against opencode 2 schema; upgrade global installation and memory server/index; document Linux/macOS/Windows service files; and update blowsh task 10 for triple transports.
extracted_decision.rationale: Complete the singleton rollout by aligning documentation, migration, upgrades, cross-platform services, and blowsh transport defaults.
alternatives: Defer upgrades or cross-platform service files
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Broad scope increases coordination and risk; macOS/Windows files will be untested in this environment; upgrades could disrupt live 7/7 setup.
